evals.name: look-up-and-build-launchpad-url
evals.prompt: Generate a Fiori Launchpad URL for the Create Maintenance Request app. Use base URL https://sap.example.com, client 100, and German language.
evals.expected_output: Looks up the app in the bundled AppList.json, uses its Semantic Object - Action value, and constructs the URL with the supplied base URL, sap-client, and sap-language parameters.

evals.name: require-fiori-client-parameter
evals.prompt: Give me the Fiori Launchpad URL for Manage Products on https://sap.example.com. I don't know the SAP client number.
evals.expected_output: Looks up the app if possible but does not fabricate a completed URL; explains that sap-client is required and asks the user to provide it.
